title: Wynn Plus
description: The Ultimate Wynncraft Experience, curated for Fruma.
body:
# **Wynn Plus**

Embark on an adventure like no other in the provinces of Wynn, Gavel and Fruma! Select your class and join millions of players in the best RPG adventure map Minecraft has to offer.

Level up, complete quests, trade, slay bosses, discover secrets and loot, capture territories with your guildmates, and much more. The choice is yours!

## **Features**

This modpack aims to provide the Ultimate Experience for exploring Wynn, utilising [Wynntils](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynntils) as a basis to enhance the user's gameplay with a variety of customizable options and additions. 

From there Wynn Plus improves the performance, visuals and gameplay of Minecraft. Some standouts being:

- 🔥 Sodium
- ☀️ Iris
- 🔭 Distant Horizons
- 🌧️ Particle Rain
- ➕ More!
